## Results

**Paper Submission Year:**
The arXiv paper 'DARCCC: Detecting Adversaries by Reconstruction from Class Conditional Capsules' (arXiv:1811.06969) was originally submitted in **November 2018**.

**US Inflation Rate for 2018 (Wolfram Alpha):**
I navigated to Wolfram Alpha (https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=US+inflation+rate+2018) and the page loaded with sections titled 'Input interpretation:', 'Result:', 'Inflation rate history:', and 'Inflation rates by product group:'. However, despite numerous attempts using various methods (extract, evaluate, search_page, shadow DOM traversal), the actual numerical inflation rate value in the 'Result:' section could not be extracted from the page — the content appeared to render as skeleton/placeholder elements without accessible text values.

The Wolfram Alpha page structure confirmed it was processing the query for US inflation rate 2018, but the specific numerical result was not successfully retrieved during this session. I was unable to confirm the exact value as reported by Wolfram Alpha.
